slots.node01.steps.item01.label: Rung 1
slots.node01.steps.item01.text: “Walk me through the last time a patient asked what a visit would cost.” Intent: get the real story, not the policy. Move on when you hear a named step.
slots.node01.steps.item01.title: Open
slots.node01.steps.item02.label: Rung 2
slots.node01.steps.item02.text: “What happened next, and who did you hand it to?” Intent: trace handoffs and waiting time. Move on when each wait has an owner.
slots.node01.steps.item02.title: Probe
slots.node01.steps.item03.label: Rung 3
slots.node01.steps.item03.text: “If the estimate came before booking, what would break?” Intent: test assumptions and find the true constraint. Move on when the constraint is named.
slots.node01.steps.item03.title: Challenge
slots.node01.steps.item04.label: Rung 4
slots.node01.steps.item04.text: “So the blocker is missing charge data. Is that right, and who owns it?” Intent: check we heard it and agree an owner. Move on when the table says yes.
slots.node01.steps.item04.title: Confirm
slots.node04.items.item01: The table names steps, owners and numbers, not opinions
slots.node04.items.item02: Quiet participants are speaking by rung 3
slots.node04.items.item03: Disagreement is stated out loud, not smoothed over
slots.node07.items.item01: Estimates: a price patients can rely on before they book.
slots.node10.items.item01: “Give me one example from this week.”
slots.node10.items.item02: “What would a new hire see on day one?”
slots.node10.items.item03: “How many times a month is that?”
slots.node13.items.item01: No challenge until the story is told.
slots.title: Question ladder for the estimates topic
